title: Pin every release-script npm call to the public registry, and read back the launcher readme after publish
description: Follow-up from confirming QCLI-399 AC4 against lore-cli LCLI-621, read by ref at opum-ai/lore-cli bb8b2662 (dev tip; #337 squash, tree identical to reviewed head e9213411). Lore does two things quest does not; neither is part of the agreed flow contract. (1) REGISTRY PINNING. Every lore npm write and read passes --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ AND --@opum-ai:registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ (their REGISTRY_PINS), with reads also passing --userconfig=/dev/null. Reproduced here on npm 12.1.0: with a project .npmrc setting @opum-ai:registry to a dead host, `npm view @opum-ai/quest@0.11.0 version --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/` fails ECONNREFUSED, and adding the scope flag succeeds. So --registry alone does not override a scope registry. Quest dist-tag READS are already pinned (anonymous fetch by URL, QCLI-390). But publish (publish-release.mjs publishArgs, promote-release.mjs launcherPublishArgs), npm dist-tag add (promote-release.mjs setTag), npm view (isPublished, bundle-integrity registryHoldsTarball, pair-receipt observe, release-provenance, native-execution-receipt) and npm pack (downloadServedTarball) all run unpinned. package.json has no publishConfig. This machine sets no scope registry (npm config get @opum-ai:registry: undefined), so the exposure is latent: an npmrc carrying @opum-ai:registry would receive the write or answer the read. (2) README READ-BACK. Lore promote-latest.mjs readBackReadme re-reads `npm view <launcher> readme` after the X publish until it is non-empty (it lags; LCLI-460 measured ~25 min). QCLI-399 AC3 is that same measurement, currently manual.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every npm publish, dist-tag add, view and pack in scripts/ that targets @opum-ai packages passes both --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ and --@opum-ai:registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/, and a test fails if a call site omits either
A test or measurement shows a project .npmrc setting @opum-ai:registry elsewhere does not redirect a pinned release-script call
promote-release.mjs reads back npm view @opum-ai/quest readme after the X publish, retrying through registry lag, and reports its byte count; an unreadable read is reported as unknown, never as 0
